subject: 🏃 Wednesday — Maintenance Strength, Taper-Light (Wk 4)
html:
Tomorrow: Maintenance strength at Cañada College — same lifts, ~60% load, 2 sets instead of 3–4. This is a taper-light session to maintain neural drive without inducing the 48–72 hr neuromuscular drag that would compromise Saturday's PAL 10K. Get in, prime the patterns, get out.

Warm-up: Foam roll quads/IT band 1 min each + glute bridges 10 reps + quadruped hip CARs 3 each leg + bodyweight squats 10 reps + RDL pattern with empty bar 10 reps.

Lifts (2 sets each, 3-sec eccentric):

  • Back squat: 100 lb, 2×6 (60% of working 165)
  • Romanian deadlift: 100 lb, 2×6 (60% of working 165 — straps if convenient, but grip shouldn't limit at this weight)
  • Standing calf raise: 25 lb/hand, 2×10 (60% of working 40)
  • Reverse Nordic: SKIP this week — too quad-fatiguing 3 days before a benchmark race

Focus cue: Treat this like a rehearsal, not a workout. Maintain the 3-sec eccentric tempo on squat and RDL — that's what keeps the neural pathways sharp. If the weight feels like air (it will), resist the urge to load up. The whole point is stimulus without cost.

Context: Week 4 of 12, Phase 1 Foundation — PAL 10K taper week. Yesterday's 6×1000m VO2 session was the last quality work before Saturday. You nailed it: all 6 reps in the 6:50–7:00 window, max HR 166, knee 1/5. From here it's downhill into the race — maintenance lift today, 4 mi easy + strides Thursday, full rest Friday, race Saturday. You're ahead of where I expected entering this week.

PT block note: The PT exercises (side plank w/ hip abd, dead bug w/ banded pulldown, chin tuck + lifts) have been dropped the last two Fridays due to time crunch. Since Friday is full rest this week, tack the PT block onto the end of today's session — it's only 5 minutes and these are the highest-leverage exercises for the medial PFJ diagnosis. No excuse to skip them when the lifting volume is this light.

Tonight: Normal dinner, hydrate, bed by 10. Lay out gym clothes and the lifting straps. This should be a 35–40 minute session door to door — quick and purposeful.
